summary.text: Bill Teeter is a Republican state representative from Arkansas House District 44 who won an August 4, 2026 special general election and is seeking a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election. His career experience includes working as an emergency responder.

paragraphs.text: Teeter's career experience includes working as an emergency responder.
He won a special Republican primary on June 2, 2026, held to fill the vacancy in nomination after the death of Stan Berry, and then won the special general election on August 4, 2026.
